mapper.select: SELECT msg_id, student_id, student_name, teacher_id, teacher_name, question_content, reply_content, is_featured, featured_title, created_at FROM qa_message WHERE student_id = #{userId} OR teacher_id = #{userId} ORDER BY msg_id DESC
SELECT msg_id, student_id, student_name, teacher_id, teacher_name, question_content, reply_content, is_featured, featured_title, created_at FROM qa_message WHERE is_featured = 1 ORDER BY msg_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_message(msg_id, student_id, student_name, teacher_id, teacher_name, question_content, reply_content, is_featured, featured_title) VALUES(#{msgId}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{questionContent}, #{replyContent}, #{isFeatured}, #{featuredTitle})
